llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed Google Ads connector skill with powerful account-changing actions, but its behavior is purpose-aligned and includes user-confirmation safeguards for writes and destructive operations.

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to operate Google Ads through OOMOL's googleads connector, and the listed read, write, and destructive actions all fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to the oo CLI Google Ads connector, require schema inspection before payload construction, and require confirmation for write and destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single markdown skill with no bundled executable files; it documents one-time oo CLI installation via remote install scripts only if the CLI is missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses OAuth-backed Google Ads access and can modify campaigns, ad groups, and customer lists, which is high-impact but expected for this integration and disclosed in the action list.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or background behavior is present, but it depends on an external OOMOL account connection where credentials are handled server-side.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust OOMOL with Google Ads connector access. Treat campaign, ad group, and customer-list operations as account-impacting actions, and require explicit review of payloads before approving writes or destructive changes.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found no hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean, and there are no executable files in the skill artifact.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no findings; the only sensitive capabilities are the disclosed Google Ads OAuth connector operations.
